name: Fuse normalization and elementwise epilogues
hypothesis: Fold normalization, activation and residual transforms into their producer or consumer while preserving the BF16 numerical contract.
derivation: Nsight attributes 0.251 ms/step to normalization and 0.051 ms/step to one repeated fused pointwise family; only a subset can be removed because normalization reductions remain mandatory.

evidence.claim: Expanded graph timing for normalization and pointwise families.
